coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting changed into work clothes
Preparing and eating a quick breakfast using the kettle and toaster
Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
Working as a health care professional on the hospital ward, patient care and charting
Taking a short lunch break in the hospital staff room
Continuing clinical duties, handover and patient rounds at the hospital
Heating and eating dinner in the microwave, avoiding the induction cooker during the peak cooking window
Taking a shower and doing personal hygiene after work
Relaxing on the sofa, checking the phone and watching TV
Winding down in bed, dimming the desk lamp and reading on the phone
